race.comment: MANPOWER (1) has been racing very consistently this time in work with two wins and two placings from four starts and gets some well-needed weight relief with the 3kg claim. Maps nicely for this contest from the inside marble and should be right there at the business end. STORMLAND (2) has placed three of four over this distance range and is another to get some weight off. Looms as the main danger. FIRE BOMBER (4) has been on the doorstep of another victory with three consecutive runner-up finishes. Anticipating another competitive performance. MARIA CLARA (12) is yet to miss a drum in four outings to date and has to be included in exotics.
